decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-32984cccce52] states the subject concretely: the deprecated `metallb-bgp` agent flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr`. It also states the change (they are removed) and the consequence (the MetalLB-based BGP path no longer provides BGP advertisements, so users must move to the Cilium BGP control plane). I don't agree with P1 that this bundles separate changes. The three flags belong to one deprecated feature, are removed together with one shared consequence, and can be written as one assertion: any environment setting any of the three flags is exposed. One gap: the evidence doesn't say whether a leftover flag makes the agent fail to start or is just ignored. Either way, the BGP advertisements are lost, so the assertion can still be written.
